subject: app-rdef
title: APP.RDEF.------P.PROG.
description: Diagram in SD(SY)-47 (Spectacle-Diversion Syndrome, Level One) accompanying Braxton's diagnostic that 'all of the signs for real change have solidified and the question now is which way will events take us … the most basic factor to induce the need for positive change is the awareness of extended information.' (C)APP-RDEF (the concept of applied redefinitions) is crossed with P-PROG (particular progressionalism): the question is what applied-redefinitions produces when crossed with particular-progressionalism — when the late-seventies progressional weight is 'isolating the dynamics of composite perception.' POL-P (political policies) and RT-ALGN (reality alignment) branch from the main line. From RT-ALGN a long line runs to W-DY, which carries CRTF-D (cross-transfer definitions), leading on to IST-F (isolated focus), and a *dashed* line to CUL-INFO-F (culture information focus) that amplifies some aspect of W-DY. IST-F in turn has a dashed line to INFO-AF-B (information affinity basis) that amplifies some aspect of it. Structural argument: applied-redefinitions crossed with particular-progressionalism is the diagnostic for the late-seventies situation — applied-redefinitions is what the dominant culture offers as 'change,' while particular-progressionalism is what actually obtains.
